incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired -> service=vector-search, incident=INC-2026-0315-77, urgency=high, subject=error rate > 5% over 5m; routed to schedule 'platform-weekend'

Noah R (oncall): seeing pages, taking a look now. @PagerDuty Bot can you paste the trigger?

PagerDuty Bot: Trigger details:
metric=api_error_rate, threshold=0.05, window=300s, hosts=[search-gpu-2, search-gpu-3], recent: 
```
2026-03-15T02:07:12Z search-gpu-2 proxy: upstream 502 x 240 in 30s
2026-03-15T02:07:13Z runtime: model inference failed: CUDA device lost
2026-03-15T02:07:15Z search-gpu-3 proxy: upstream 504 x 310
```

Ivy L (eng-sre): wait — vector-search should route to vector-oncall, not platform-weekend. platform-weekend is the infra rotation for weekend maintenance; they're currently awake and reporting unrelated deploys. Looks like schedule-sync-bot pushed an erroneous map earlier. @schedule-sync-bot any recent runs?

schedule-sync-bot: cron job sync-pd-bindings ran at 2026-03-15T01:55:02Z. Diff summary: 1 changed binding: serviceId svc-vector -> schedule:platform-weekend (was schedule:vector-oncall). Change initiated by pipeline: ci/pd-sync:deploy-9

Noah R (oncall): ouch. Platform folks will be paged instead of vector team. Diane, are customers reporting impact?

Diane M (support): yes — a few integration partners seeing retries and 502s since 02:05. Roughly 3 high-volume tenants. Support page created: STS-341. We're posting interim notice.

Ivy L (eng-sre): mitigation steps: 1) suppress pages to platform-weekend for this incident (they're mid-deploy), 2) rebind svc-vector back to schedule:vector-oncall, 3) scale vector-search pool and recycle the CUDA hosts, 4) run a PD-binding audit. I'll do 1 & 2.

Noah R (oncall): suppress please. Also pref to add a temporary rule that routes to vector-oncall immediately even if sync job later reverts.

Ivy L (eng-sre): muting platform-weekend for this incident:
```
pd incident mute --id INC-2026-0315-77 --scope schedule:platform-weekend --duration 45m
```

PagerDuty Bot: Mute applied: platform-weekend suppressed for 45m on INC-2026-0315-77.

Ivy L (eng-sre): patching PD binding now (manual override):
```
pd edit_binding --service svc-vector --target schedule:vector-oncall --author ivy.l
```

PagerDuty Bot: Binding updated. change_id=CHG-7890. New primary schedule: vector-oncall.

Ivy L (eng-sre): running test-route:
```
pd test-route --service svc-vector
# result: primary=vector-oncall, secondary=eng-sre-rotations
```

Noah R (oncall): good. Diane, can you correlate customer errors to host drain? Might be HOTSPOT on search-gpu-2.

Diane M (support): support logs show spike on search-gpu-2 with device-reset events in vendor logs. Customers see intermittent 502 then retries succeed.

Ivy L (eng-sre): I'm initiating cordon+drain of search-gpu-2 and parallel scale up of replacement host. Commands: 
```
kubectl annotate node search-gpu-2 cordon=drain-requested
kubectl drain search-gpu-2 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=60
autoscaler scale pool vector-search +1
```

Noah R (oncall): I'll shadow for 15m to watch latency/errs.

schedule-sync-bot: note: the previous CI job ci/pd-sync:deploy-9 included a mapping change due to an automated heuristic which collapsed two services with similar names (vector & vector-search) into svc-vector. The heuristic is deprecated but not gated.

Ivy L (eng-sre): that's the root cause then — sync bot's heuristic matched legacy and new service labels. Short-term fix: disable heuristic in ci/pd-sync. Long-term: add strict canonical names check.

Diane M (support): customer updates: sent 'mitigation in progress' to 3 tenants. One reported temporary API degradations but says retries worked.

Ivy L (eng-sre): drain complete on search-gpu-2, replacement host search-gpu-9 up and taking traffic. Memory and GPU health stable. No further device resets in last 4m.

Noah R (oncall): verified via sampled tenants — error rate back to baseline. I'll keep watch for 30m. Diane please send follow-up to customers that service recovered and postmortem forthcoming.

Ivy L (eng-sre): filing follow-ups:
- TKT-2142: disable heuristic in ci/pd-sync and add unit tests for canonical service ids
- RFC-2143: PD binding audit and one-time reconciliation across org
- RUNBOOK-vec: add guidance for runbook step to prefer manual override when sync job run during incident windows

schedule-sync-bot: queued job to run a full-bindings-audit in 10m and will report mismatches.

PagerDuty Bot: Incident INC-2026-0315-77 acknowledged by vector-oncall (Noah R). Ownership transferred.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-0315-77 status -> monitoring. Duration so far 00:12:51. Summary: automated binding change from PD sync pipeline routed vector-search alerts to platform-weekend; mitigation: muted platform schedule, restored binding to vector-oncall, drained faulty host, scaled pool, customer notices sent. Follow-ups created.

Noah R (oncall): thanks all. I'll draft a brief blameless postmortem and link tickets. Leaving this thread open for the 30m watch. :thumbsup:
